ITEM 1 | Multiple thin strips of cooked meat with dark reddish-brown to amber coloring, glossy and slightly oily sheen, crisp-looking edges with some darker charred spots, flat ribbon-like strips about 1 cm wide and 8-12 cm long, some curled and overlapping in a loose pile on a white square plate about 20 cm across, covering roughly 45% of the plate surface | 45

ITEM 2 | Layered pile of rendered fatty and lean strips with alternating pale rose and deep brown bands, stacked up to about 1 cm high in the center, edges slightly crisp and translucent, sitting on the white plate with no sauce or liquid visible | 15
